title: The Night Garden
text: A garden of pale flowers that bloom only in the dark, white as bone, wide open, swaying. Their scent is heavy and sweet as old perfume. Breathe it, and you forget why you came. Breathe it longer, and you forget there was anywhere else.

options.label: Pick a pale flower each, and breathe deep of forgetting.

outcomes.text: Sweet forgetting, and rest, and you do not dream.
You forget the way, and walk somewhere you did not mean to go.

options.label: The toughest holds their breath and leads the rest through the scent.

outcomes.text: Out, gasping, all of you. The one who led spent everything on it, and comes out with their blood up.

options.label: The wisest studies the flowers, to learn what they could be made into.

outcomes.text: A drug for sleepless nights, worth its weight, and worse in larger doses.

options.label: The Alterer changes their own lungs to bear the scent, and leads the way.

outcomes.text: Their chest goes strange and wide for an hour, and they lead the party through on one long breath. It hurts, after.
